overview_description.description: Blueloop develops software for financial service applications. Their software products include swapmonkey and flux. Swapmonkey is a peer to peer cryptocurrency platform. Swapmonkey allows trading cryptocurrencies. Flux is a platform that offers a secure solution to send money between countries using blockchain technology to power payments.
